blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Single image 3D generation aims to dress a given 3D mesh with relightable materials while faithfully preserving the visual details of a reference image. Existing methods either introduce artifacts when fusing inconsistent multi-view predictions or struggle to preserve fine details through implicit image-feature conditioning. To resolve these challenges, we introduce SUPRA-Tex, built on the principle of decoupling visible-material estimation, surface alignment, and observation-guided 3D completion. This division of labor allows the 3D generator, trained on limited 3D data, to focus its capacity on preserving visible evidence and completing unobserved surfaces. Specifically, we first train an MLLM-based image editing model to predict lighting-separated PBR maps in the reference view. We then project these maps onto the visible surface and encode them with the pretrained material VAE encoder into native observation latents that share the generation target's latent space. An interleaved flow transformer holds these latents as fixed, read-only anchors while alternating unobserved-region and full-surface updates to generate complete material latents. This design achieves super-alignment with the reference, delivering What You See Is What You Get fidelity on visible regions and coherent completion on unobserved surfaces. Trained solely on public datasets, SUPRA-Tex achieves SOTA performance in both geometry-conditioned texturing and end-to-end asset generation, matching or even exceeding leading commercial systems on in-the-wild images. Project page: https://supra-3d.github.io/supratex/

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: For applications such as product digitization and embodied AI, generating relightable 3D assets from a single reference image requires faithful preservation of the reference appearance. We refer to this requirement as super-alignment : accurately reproducing fine-grained text, logos, and patterns at their corresponding visible surface locations, while completing unobserved regions with materials consistent with the visible appearance.
blocks.zh: 对于产品数字化等应用和所体现AI,从单一的参考图像中生成可发光的3D资产需要忠实地保存参考外观. 我们将此要求称为超对接:准确复制其相应可见地表位置的精细文字、标志和图案,同时用与可见外观相符合的材料完成未观测区域。

blocks.en: Two prominent approaches to appearance generation are multi-view synthesis and native 3D generation. Multi-view pipelines leverage geometry-conditioned 2D generative models to synthesize appearance across surrounding viewpoints, then project and fuse the resulting images onto the mesh ( Tencent Hunyuan3D Team, 2025b ) . However, cross-view discrepancies can introduce seams and ghosting, while blending conflicting predictions blurs sharp reference details ( Lai et al., 2026 ; Zeng et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 外观生成的两种突出方法是多视合成和本土3D生成. 多景管利用几何条件的2D基因模型合成相近视的外观,然后将由此产生的图像投影并装入网格(Tencent Hunyuan3D Team, 2025b.). 然而,交叉视差可以引入接合和幽灵,而混合相冲突的预测会模糊尖锐的参考细节(Lai等,2026;Zeng等,2026).

blocks.en: Native 3D generation circumvents view-fusion artifacts by synthesizing appearance directly on 3D representations ( Lai et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Zeng et al., 2026 ; Xiang et al., 2026 ) , yet preserving fine reference details remains challenging. For example, TRELLIS.2 employs a 3D material VAE to compress surface PBR properties into material latents, which are generated under geometry and image conditioning before being decoded into surface materials. Its image cross-attention provides no explicit correspondence between image details and 3D surface locations, leaving the generator to learn where those details belong. To improve spatial alignment, recent work lifts high-resolution image features into 3D through camera projection ( Li et al., 2026a ) . Yet even with explicit spatial correspondence, these conditions remain visual features rather than material observations. Consequently, the 3D generator must simultaneously shoulder the responsibilities of inferring PBR properties from visual features, reconstructing fine reference details at their corresponding surface locations, and synthesizing materials for unobserved regions.
blocks.zh: 原生的3D世代通过直接在3D表示上合成外观来规避取景文物(Lai等,2026;Chen等,2026;Zeng等,2026;Xiang等,2026),然而保留精细的参考细节仍然具有挑战性. 例如,TRELLIS.2采用3D材料VAE来将表面PBR特性压缩为材料潜出物,在几何和图像调节下生成后再解码为表面材料. 它的图像交叉意向没有在图像细节和三维地表位置之间提供明确的对应,让生成器去了解这些细节属于何处. 为了改善空间相配,近期的工作通过相机投影将高分辨率图像特征提升到3D上(Li等,2026a.). 然而,即使有明确的空间通信,这些条件仍然是视觉特征,而不是物质观测。 因此,3D生成器必须同时承担从视觉特征中推断PBR属性的责任,在相应的地表位置重建精细的参考细节,并为未观测区域合成材料.

blocks.en: We argue that these responsibilities should not fall on a single 3D generator. Given the inherent scarcity of 3D training data, requiring the 3D model to learn these heterogeneous tasks jointly increases its learning burden. Instead, we offload visible-material estimation to 2D generative priors and establish explicit surface alignment through camera projection, separating both from the 3D generative task. Our key insight is to translate visible reference evidence into native material observations before 3D generation, then organize full-surface completion around this grounded evidence. Rather than forcing the 3D model to infer physical materials from abstract visual features, this formulation enables the generator to anchor directly on established material evidence, preserving reference details while focusing more of its capacity on completing unobserved surfaces.
blocks.zh: 我们主张,这些责任不应落在单一的3D生成器上。 鉴于三维培训数据的固有稀缺性,要求三维模式共同学习这些不同的任务会加重其学习负担. 相反,我们把可见材料估计值卸入2D基因前科,并通过相机投影确定明显的表面对齐,将两者与3D基因任务分开. 我们的关键见解是在三维生成之前将可见的参考证据转化为本土物质观测,然后围绕这些有依据的证据组织全地完成. 这种配方不是强迫3D模型从抽象的视觉特征推断出物理材料,而是使生成者能够直接地以已建立的物质证据为锚地,保存参考细节,同时将更多的能力集中于完成无法观察的表面.

blocks.en: Based on this principle, we introduce SUPRA-Tex , a framework for generating relightable 3D assets with super-aligned textures. First, we leverage strong 2D priors by training an MLLM-based image editing model to jointly predict lighting-separated PBR maps in the reference view in a single forward pass, while preserving fine visual details. Next, we project these maps onto valid visible surface locations and encode the resulting partial materials with the pretrained material VAE encoder into native observation latents . Sharing the target latent space and directly decodable by the pretrained material decoder, these latents provide spatially aligned material content rather than abstract visual features that the 3D backbone must translate into PBR properties. We also encode the spatial extent of these observations to guide completion.
blocks.zh: 基于这一原则,我们引入了 SUPRA-Tex, 一个生成具有超相通纹理的可发光3D资产的框架. 首先,我们通过培训基于 MLLM 的图像编辑模型来利用强大的2D前传,在单个前传的参考视图中联合预测照明分离的PBR地图,同时保留精细的视觉细节. 接下来,我们把这些地图投射到有效的可见地表位置上,并将由此产生的部分材料用经过预先训练的材料VAE编码器编码成原生观测潜质。 共享目标潜在空间并被被预先训练出的材料解码器直接解码,这些潜在空间提供了空间相适应的物质内容,而不是3D主干线必须转化为PBR属性的抽象视觉特征. 我们还编码了这些观测的空间范围,以指导完成工作。

blocks.en: To guide full-surface material generation, we design an interleaved flow transformer that reads the native observation latents as fixed, read-only reference memory at every block. Its blocks alternate between updating unobserved latent cells and the full surface, allocating more updates to cells without observations while retaining full-surface interactions for coherent completion. Since observations are indexed by 3D surface coordinates, the same interface incorporates additional views, including 2D-generated back views, and interactive 2D edits without retraining the 3D backbone. Through this division of labor, SUPRA-Tex delivers What You See Is What You Get fidelity in the reference view while completing the asset with globally coherent, relightable materials, as illustrated in Fig. .
blocks.zh: 为了引导全地表材料生成,我们设计出一个相接叶流变压器,将原生观测潜入读取为每个区块的固定,只读的参考内存. 它的区块在更新未观测到的潜在细胞和整个地表之间交替进行,将更多的更新分配给没有观测的细胞,同时保留全地表相互作用,以连贯地完成. 由于观测以3D地表坐标为索引,同一界面包含额外的视图,包括由2D生成的后视,以及互动的2D编辑而无需再培训3D主干. 通过这种分工,SUPRA-Tex提供 如图中所示,在使用全球连贯、可燃的材料完成资产时,参考视图中的“你所看到的是忠诚”。

blocks.en:
Using only public datasets for training, SUPRA-Tex achieves SOTA results in both geometry-conditioned texturing and end-to-end asset generation. With synthetic back-view conditioning, SUPRA-Tex achieves reference fidelity and visual quality on real photographs comparable to or better than those of the leading commercial systems in our comparisons.
Code and checkpoints are released on our project page to facilitate future research: supra-3d.github.io/supratex .
blocks.zh:
SUPRA-Tex只使用公共数据集进行培训,实现了SOTA在几何条件纹理和端到端资产生成两方面的结果。 SUPRA-Tex在合成后视条件下,在真实相片上实现了与我们比较中的主要商业系统相类似或更好的参考忠实和视觉质量。
我们的项目网页上发布了代码和检查站,以便利今后的研究:上至-3d.github.io/supratex。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en: • Our key insight is to establish surface-aligned material observations before 3D generation, allowing the generator to focus on preserving reference details and completing unobserved surfaces. Built on this insight, SUPRA-Tex is trained solely on public datasets and, with synthetic back-view conditioning, achieves reference fidelity and visual quality comparable to or better than those of leading commercial systems in our comparisons. • We present native observation encoding , which projects reference-view PBR estimates onto valid surface locations and encodes partial materials in the target latent space, simplifying learning to preserve reference appearance. • We propose an interleaved flow transformer that uses fixed, read-only observation anchors and alternates unobserved-cell and full-surface updates for reference-faithful, coherent material completion.

blocks.en: 2  Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Multi-view texture generation. Most texturing pipelines synthesize appearance in 2D views and fuse the predictions onto the mesh. Early approaches paint the mesh view-by-view with depth-guided diffusion and inpaint unobserved UV regions ( Richardson et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ; Zeng et al., 2024a ) . TexFusion aggregates view-wise denoising predictions in a shared latent texture map ( Cao et al., 2023 ) . Subsequent works improve cross-view coherence by synchronizing multi-view denoising ( Liu et al., 2024b ; Cheng et al., 2025 ; Bensadoun et al., 2024 ) or generating views jointly via geometry-conditioned diffusion ( Huang et al., 2025b ; Shao et al., 2025 ; Liang et al., 2026 ; Han et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) , a recipe also adopted by large image-to-3D systems ( Zhang et al., 2024a ; Li et al., 2025b ; Tencent Hunyuan3D Team, 2025a ) .
Reference-guided methods also explicitly target appearance preservation: EASI-Tex combines mesh-edge guidance with image features for single-image texturing ( Perla et al., 2024 ) , while AlignTex aligns multi-view artwork with the mesh before projection and texture refinement ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) .
Optimization-based approaches such as DreamMat distill geometry- and light-aware diffusion priors into PBR materials ( Zhang et al., 2024b ) . Paint-it instead optimizes convolutionally parameterized PBR texture maps with score distillation ( Youwang et al., 2024 ) .
To produce relightable assets, multi-view generation is extended to PBR channels using lighting-aware priors, material latent representations, or alternating view-space baking ( Deng et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2025a ; He et al., 2025a ; Yeo et al., 2026 ; Feng et al., 2025 ; Tencent Hunyuan3D Team, 2025b ; Lai et al., 2025 ; Bao et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026b ) , often aided by single-image intrinsic delighting ( Kocsis et al., 2024 ; Zeng et al., 2024b ; Ke et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2025b ; Careaga and Aksoy, 2024 ) . Nevertheless, residual inconsistencies between synthesized views can blur or ghost sharp reference details during projection and blending. In contrast, SUPRA-Tex completes materials in native 3D space, using projected observations as conditioning anchors rather than directly fusing synthesized views into the final texture.
blocks.zh:
多视图纹理生成. 大多数纹理管道将外观合成到2D视图中,并将预测线接入网格. 早期的方法将网景逐一涂上深度导出并涂上未观测到的紫外线区域(Richardson等,2023;Chen等,2023;Zeng等,2024a). TexFusion 聚合物在共享潜在纹理图中视同去诺能预测(Cao等,2023年)。 随后的作品通过同步多视图去声来提高交叉视图的一致性(Liu等,2024b; Cheng等,2025; Bensadoun等,2024.)或通过几何条件传播共同产生观点(Huang等,2025.b;Shao等,2025.;Liang等,2026.;Han等,2026.;Zhang等,2026.),也是由大型成像到3D系统采用的配方(Zhang等,2024a;Li等,2025.b;Tencent Hunyuan3D Team,2025a.).
参考指导方法还明确了外观保护的目标:EASI-Tex将网格制导与图像特征相结合,用于单相图纹理(Perla等,2024年),而AlignTex则在投影和纹理完善前将多相图艺术与网格相协调(Zhang等,2025b.).
基于优化的方法如DreamMat蒸馏几何和光知扩散先入为PBR材料(Zhang等,2024b.). Paint-it 取而代之的是将分数蒸馏的PBR纹理图进行进化参数化优化(Youwang等,2024.
为了产生可发光资产,利用照明感知前兆、物质潜在表现或交替取景空间烘焙,将多视图生成扩展到PBR通道(Den等,2024;Huang等,2025a;He等,2025a; Yeo等,2026;Feng等,2025;Tencent Hunyuan3D Team, 2025b; Lai等, 2025; Bao等, 2026; Wu等, 2026b.),常由单相图内在取悦而来 (Kocsis等, 2024; Zeng等, 2024b; Ke等, 2025; Chen等, 2024; He等, 2025b; Careaga和Aksoy, 2024). 尽管如此,被合成的观点之间仍然存在的不一致,在投影和混入过程中会模糊或隐藏尖锐的参考细节. 相形之下,SUPRA-Tex在原生的3D空间完成材料,将预测的观测作为调节锚来使用,而不是直接使被引信的视图合成到最后的纹理.

blocks.en: Native texture generation. Driven by the rise of large-scale 3D pretraining, native texture generation has emerged as an alternative paradigm. Existing approaches explore diffusion over point, octree, and UV representations ( Yu et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024a ; Yu et al., 2024 ) and PBR prediction with octree-aligned Gaussians ( Xiong et al., 2025 ) . Latent texture generators, such as NaTex, LaFiTe, and TEXTRIX, learn structured latent spaces for surface colors or attributes ( Lai et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Zeng et al., 2026 ) , while native 3D foundation models jointly represent geometry and appearance ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Xiang et al., 2025 ; Xiang et al., 2026 ) . Beyond global conditioning, partial observations and spatially aligned features have also been explored. At scene scale, WorldGrow ( Li et al., 2026b ) extends TRELLIS with context-conditioned 3D block inpainting for progressive scene generation. TEXGen back-projects partial UV maps ( Yu et al., 2024 ) , NaTex encodes initial textures for refinement ( Lai et al., 2026 ) , and TEXTRIX encodes projected appearance with its pretrained attribute VAE in the generation target’s latent space ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) . For spatial feature alignment, camera projection techniques originally developed for implicit reconstruction ( Saito et al., 2019 ; Yu et al., 2021a ) have been adapted to 3D generative models, such as CUPID’s pose-aligned features and Pixal3D’s camera-frame back-projected multi-scale features ( Huang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ) . Even with spatially aligned image features, the 3D generator must still infer material properties, preserve reference details, and complete unobserved surfaces.
blocks.zh: 原生纹理生成. 在大规模3D预训的兴起的推动下,本土纹理生成已经成为一种替代范式. 现有方法探索在点上传播、octree和紫外线表示(Yu等人,2023;Liu等人,2024a; Yu等,2024年)和与octree-accessed Gaussians的PBR预测(Xiong等,2025年). 后期纹理发生器,如NaTex,LaFiTe和TEXTRIX,学习地表颜色或属性的结构化潜在空间(Lai等,2026;Chen等,2026;Zeng等,2026;而原生的3D地基模型共同代表几何和外观(Chen等,2025;Xiang等,2025;Xiang等,2026). 除了全球条件外,还探索了部分观测和空间相通的特点。 在场景尺度上,"WorldGrow"(Li等,2026b)用上下文条件的3D块涂装来扩展TRELLIS,以进行进步场景生成. blocks.en: 3  Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Given a reference image I I , a mesh ℳ \mathcal{M} , and its camera projection π \pi , SUPRA-Tex generates full-surface, relightable PBR materials. Figure 1 summarizes the three stages: reference-view material estimation, surface-aligned native observation encoding, and observation-guided 3D completion. We first introduce the material representation and upstream geometry model, then describe the three stages, training objective, and inference procedure. Appendices A and B provide implementation and training details; Appendix G.1 describes additional-view conditioning and texture editing.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of SUPRA-Tex. Left: image-to-material translation. A 2D material translator estimates lighting-separated albedo, metallic, and roughness maps from a single reference image. Middle: native observation encoding. Using the mesh ℳ \mathcal{M} and camera projection π \pi , we project valid predictions onto visible surface voxels and omit unobserved voxels from the partial PBR input. The frozen material encoder E mat E_{\mathrm{mat}} maps these partial PBR attributes into the generation target’s latent space. These latents, together with coverage and boundary metadata, form the observation representation 𝒞 o \mathcal{C}_{o} . Right: observation-guided completion. Conditioned on geometry latents G G , the interleaved flow transformer generates complete material latents Z 0 Z_{0} from noise Z 1 Z_{1} . blocks.en: Joint alignment and one-step inference. To coordinate channel predictions while retaining pretrained image priors, F 2 ​ D F_{\mathrm{2D}} adapts a multimodal DiT backbone ( Super Intelligence Team, 2026 ) via factorized modality-axis joint attention , jointly predicting albedo, metallic–roughness, and auxiliary normal maps. This attention exchanges features across output modalities at corresponding spatial locations. We train the 2D material estimator on RGB images paired with ground-truth material and normal maps rendered from Objaverse, using a latent flow-matching objective at the fixed maximum-noise endpoint σ = 1.0 \sigma=1.0 . At inference, a single DiT forward pass at this endpoint (1.2 s on one H800) estimates clean material latents, which the VAE decodes into 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 material maps without iterative denoising.

blocks.en: This design has two advantages. First, it uses 2D image priors to disentangle illumination from intrinsic materials at full reference resolution. Second, it shields the downstream 3D generator from abstract visual features, letting the 3D model use physical PBR observations to focus on reference preservation and unobserved-surface completion.

blocks.en: 3.4  Observation-Guided Completion
blocks.zh: 3.4 观察-指导完成

blocks.en: We generate complete material latents via flow matching over the mesh ℳ \mathcal{M} , predicting a velocity field at time t t from the current noisy material latents Z t Z_{t} , geometry latents G G , and native observation representation 𝒞 o \mathcal{C}_{o} ( Lipman et al., 2023 ) . Native observation latents provide spatially aligned material evidence for reconstructing visible appearance. The generator must learn to use this evidence while completing unobserved surfaces coherently. Pixal3D ⋆ injects projected image features through additive residuals and updates all surface tokens at every layer. We introduce an interleaved flow transformer that retains observations as fixed, read-only memory and alternates unobserved-cell and full-surface updates. This schedule assigns more hidden-state updates to unobserved cells while allowing visible materials to be refined during full-surface generation.
blocks.zh: 我们通过在网格M\mathcal{M}上相匹配的流来产生完整的物质潜质,从当前吵闹的物质潜出Z t-Z_{t}中预测出一个时 t t 的速度场,几何潜出G G,以及原生观测代表 C o\mathcal{C}_{o} (Lipman等,2023年). 原生观测潜出物为重建可见外观提供了空间相通的物质证据. 发电机必须学会使用这些证据,同时连贯地完成无法观察的表面。 Pixal3D QQ通过添加剂残留来注入预测的图像特征,并更新了每层的所有表面标志. 我们引入了互放流变器,保留了作为固定的,只读的内存和备用的无观测细胞和全表面更新的观测. 这个调度为未观测到的细胞分配了更隐蔽的状态更新,同时允许在全表面生成时对可见材料进行精炼.

blocks.en: Datasets. Our 3D material generator is trained solely on publicly available 3D datasets. The training sources are summarized in Appendix B.1 . We evaluate on two datasets with no overlap with the training set: DTC-Tex, comprising 100 texture-rich product scans selected from the Digital Twin Catalog ( Dong et al., 2025 ) , and Complex-Tex, comprising 110 Sketchfab ( Sketchfab, n.d. ) meshes with denser inscriptions, finer patterns, and more varied shapes.
blocks.zh: 数据集. 我们的3D材料生成器只接受公开的3D数据集的培训. 培训来源摘要见附录B.1。 我们对两个与培训组没有重叠的数据集进行评价:DTC-Tex, 包括从数字双子目录(Dong等人,2025年)中选取的100个纹理丰富的产品扫描;和Complex-Tex, 包括110个Sketchfab(Sketchfab, n.d.)有更密集的铭文、更精细的图案和更多样化的形状。

blocks.en: Implementation details. The 2D material estimator adapts FireRed-Image-Edit-1.1 ( Super Intelligence Team, 2026 ) at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 resolution. The 3D generator uses 60 Transformer blocks, with self-attention initialized from TRELLIS.2 and the remaining components initialized randomly; the pretrained material encoder and decoder remain frozen. We train the generator with a global batch size of 576 using AdamW on 64 GPUs. Inference uses 25 Euler steps without classifier-free guidance.
blocks.zh: 执行细节。 2D物质估计器以1024×1024 1024\times 1024分辨率调整了FireRed-Image-Edit-1.1(超级情报团队,2026). 3D生成器使用60个变形器块,自取自TRELLIS.2而自取自出,其余组件被随机初始化;被预训的材料编码器和解码器仍然被冻结. 我们使用64个GPU上的AdamW来训练全球分批大小为576的发电机. 推论使用25个欧拉步骤而不用无分级制导.

blocks.en: Setting and baselines. Each method textures the ground-truth mesh from a single forward-lit reference image. We record the ground-truth lighting and camera poses and render each textured result under these same conditions at the reference view and 15 novel views, isolating material quality from geometry, pose, and illumination differences. Table 1 compares ten baselines spanning native 3D generation and dedicated texturing methods. PBR methods are additionally evaluated on albedo, metallic, and roughness.

blocks.en: Results. Table 1 shows that SUPRA-Tex leads across all shaded and PBR metrics on both datasets. Compared with feature-conditioned Pixal3D ⋆ , shaded PSNR improves by 1.7 dB and 1.2 dB, and albedo PSNR fg by 2.0 dB and 0.9 dB on DTC-Tex and Complex-Tex, respectively. The gains over multi-view PBR methods are larger: LumiTex trails by more than 2 dB in shaded PSNR and by over 1.5 dB in albedo PSNR on both datasets. The albedo gains and lowest metallic/roughness MAE show that the improvements extend to material attributes. Figure 2 shows that SUPRA-Tex better preserves the mug’s fine lettering and the plate’s intricate patterns than multi-view and feature-conditioned baselines, while novel-view renderings show coherent appearance on the completed surfaces.
blocks.zh: 结果。 表1显示,SUPRA-Tex在两个数据集中都领先于所有阴影和PBR度量衡。 相较于地貌条件的Pixal3D QQ,被遮蔽的PSNR改进了1.7分贝和1.2分贝;而DTC-Tex和Complex-Tex上的反照率为2.0分贝和0.9分贝. 多视图PBR方法的增益更大:LumiTex分道扬镳的PSNR分出2分贝以上,两个数据集分出1.5分贝以上. 反照率增益和最低的金属/地平面磁共振显示,改进扩大到物质属性。 图2显示,SUPRA-Tex比多视图和有特征条件的基线更好地保存了杯子的精细字母和盘子的复杂图案,而新颖的视角渲染则在完成的表面呈现出连贯的外观.

SUPRA-Tex and Pixal3D ⋆ share geometry predicted by the latter, with separate appearance pipelines. Other baselines generate their own geometry. blocks.zh: 我们与TRELLIS.2、Pixal3D ⋆、Hunyuan3D 2.1、Step1X-3D、UniLat3D和CUPID(Xiang等,2026;Li等,2026a;Tencent Hunyuan3D)进行比较。 Team,2025b;Li等人,2025a;Wu等人,2026a; Huang et al., 2026). SUPRA-Tex和Pixal3D QQ 共享后者所预测的几何,有单独的外观管. 其他基线产生自己的几何. 对于评分,输出被带入一个共同的坐标框架,GT相似度对表3中标有 \\dagger 的方法进行了比对;这种比对在生成中没有作用.

blocks.en: Results. Table 3 shows that SUPRA-Tex leads across all 9 9 metrics on both datasets. Relative to Pixal3D ⋆ , four-view PSNR improves by 1.77 dB on DTC-Tex and 2.49 dB on Complex-Tex, foreground PSNR by 0.89 dB and 1.60 dB, and LPIPS decreases by 64.8% and 58.6%, respectively. Higher reference-view CLIP-I and lower 16-view distribution distances further indicate stronger input consistency and multi-view appearance quality. Since Pixal3D ⋆ and SUPRA-Tex share predicted geometry, these results show that our appearance pipeline retains its advantage on predicted surfaces, complementing the given-geometry results in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 结果。 表3显示,SUPRA-Tex在两个数据集中都领先于所有9个度数。 相较于Pixal3D QQ,四景PSNR在DTC-Tex上改进了1.77 dB和在Complex-Tex上改进了2.49 dB,前景PSNR在0.89 dB和1.60 dB上分别减少了64.8%和58.6%. 更高的参考-视图 CLIP-I和较低的16-视图分布距离进一步表明更强的输入一致性和多视图外观质量. 由于 Pixal3D 和 SUPRA-Tex 共享预测几何,这些结果显示我们的外观管道保留了它在预测地表上的优势,补充了表1给出的几何结果.

blocks.en: 4.4  Ablation and Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.4 分析和分析

blocks.en: We evaluate the observation-injection architecture and material content under the given-geometry protocol of Sec. 4.1 . The architecture variants share training data, initialization protocol, optimization settings, training budget, and checkpoint-selection rule. All comparisons use the same geometry, cameras, valid observation support, and sampling seed.
blocks.zh: 我们根据第4.1条的定点几何协议评估观测注入结构和物质内容。 架构变体共享培训数据,初始化协议,优化设置,培训预算,以及检查站选取规则. 所有比较都使用相同的几何,相机,有效的观测支持,以及取样种子.

blocks.en: How observations are used. Table 5 compares three conditioning designs with the same predicted PBR observations. Residual injection adds encoded observations through layerwise residuals. Joint-update attention updates observation states in selected layers and all generation states in every layer. In contrast, SUPRA-Tex keeps observations read-only and alternates unobserved-cell and full-surface updates (Sec. 3.4 ). It improves shaded PSNR fg over residual injection by 0.87 dB on DTC-Tex and 0.29 dB on Complex-Tex, and matches joint-update attention in shaded fidelity while improving albedo PSNR fg by 0.15 and 0.16 dB with lower MR MAE. Thus, the design preserves or improves reconstruction quality without spending computation on observation-state updates or full-surface queries at every block. The complete design also samples 1.20 × 1.20\times and 1.18 × 1.18\times faster than joint-update attention on the two datasets (Sec. 4.5 ).
blocks.zh: 如何用观察. 表5比较了三种调节设计与相同的预测PBR观测. 残留注射通过分层残留添加了编码观测. 联合更新的注意更新了所选地层中的观测状态,以及每地层中的所有生成状态. 相形之下,SUPRA-Tex只保留了可读和可替代的无观测单元格和全地表更新(第3.4节)。 它在 DTC-Tex 上将PSNR fg 的遮蔽度提高 0.87分贝 在 DTC-Tex 上将 0.29分贝 在 Complex-Tex 上将联合更新的注意度与 遮蔽的忠度相匹配,同时将反照度提高 0.15分贝和0.16分贝 与较低的 MR MAE相匹配。 因此,该设计保留或改进了重建质量,而不花在每一个区块的观察状态更新或全地表查询上. 完整的设计还取样了1.20×1.20\时间和1.18×1.18\时间,比两个数据集的联合更新注意速度快(第4.5条)。

blocks.en: Effectiveness of 2D material estimation. To test whether the FireRed-based 2D material estimator supplies useful physical material estimates, we replace its predicted metallic and roughness with fixed values ( M = 0 , R = 0.5 M=0,R=0.5 ) or dataset means, keeping predicted albedo and the 3D generator unchanged (Table 5 ). Relative to fixed and dataset-mean MR, predicted MR improves shaded PSNR fg by 0.44 and 0.26 dB on DTC-Tex, and 0.69 and 0.57 dB on Complex-Tex, respectively, with lower MR MAE on both datasets. These gains show that the 2D estimates provide useful material information beyond albedo alone. Replacing all predicted PBR channels with ground truth (Oracle PBR) further improves shaded PSNR fg by 2.31/1.12 dB and albedo PSNR fg by 2.62/2.51 dB on DTC-Tex/Complex-Tex. The remaining gap indicates that improving 2D material estimation can further improve 3D texture quality without changing the completion model. Using Qwen-Image-2.1 ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) (Ours ‡ in Table 1 ) narrows this oracle gap to 0.98/0.47 dB in shaded PSNR fg and 1.03/2.36 dB in albedo PSNR fg . The same completion model therefore works with a different 2D prior, and a stronger prior improves 3D texture quality toward the oracle.
blocks.zh: 2D物质估计的有效性. 为了测试以FireRed为基础的2D物质估计器是否提供有用的物理物质估计值,我们用固定值(M=0,R=0.5M=0,R=0.5)或数据集手段取代其预测的金属和粗糙度,使预测反照率和3D生成器保持不变(表5)。 相对于固定和数据集-平均值MR,预测的MR在DTC-Tex上分别将阴影PSNR fg改进为0.44和0.26分贝,在Complex-Tex上则分别改进为0.69和0.57分贝,两个数据集的MR MAE更低. 这些收益表明,2D估算提供了超出反照率的有用材料信息。 用地真(Oracle PBR)来取代所有预测的PBR通道,进一步改善了遮蔽的PSNR fg 2.31/1.12 dB和反照率的PSNR fg 2.62/2.5.51 dB在DTC-Tex/Complex-Tex上. 所剩空白表明,改进2D材料估计可以进一步提高3D纹理质量而无需改变完成模型. 使用Quen-Image-2.1(Quen Team,2026年)(表1中的"我们")将这个甲骨文差距缩小到被遮蔽的PSNR fg中的0.98/0.47 dB和反照率的1.03/2.36 dB. 因此,同一完成模型与前作不同的2D相配合,而前作更强能向甲骨文改进3D纹理质量.

(b) Decoded albedo for three cases selected by latent-difference percentile, with shared GT-selected crops. PSNR covers all retained observed GT voxels, not only the displayed crops.
blocks.zh: 图4:用GT几何和材料进行原生观测编码. (a) 有效复合Tex物体之间的部分和完全潜在差异。 (b) 以潜在偏差百分位数选择的3个病例的编码反照率,共用GT所选作物。 PSNR覆盖了所有被观察到的GT花瓶,而不仅仅是所显示的作物.

blocks.en: Partial and complete material encoding. Sharing the material encoder does not imply that a partial observation yields the corresponding slice of a complete-material latent. We isolate this distinction using GT geometry, cameras, and PBR values on Complex-Tex, bypassing both 2D prediction and flow generation. For each object, we encode complete materials and the filtered visible subset with the same frozen encoder using its posterior mean, then compare features at identical observed coordinates. We measure the RMS difference over coordinates and channels after dividing each channel by its fixed material-latent standard deviation, and average the resulting scores equally across objects. We retain objects that pass the coordinate and projection checks, excluding failed projection-IoU checks or incompatible geometry/material support. All retained objects have nonzero differences: the mean standardized RMS is 0.713 (95% object-bootstrap interval 0.684–0.742), with median 0.680, while repeated encoding of identical inputs gives zero difference (Fig. 4 a). Thus, partial encoding changes representations even for unchanged input materials.
blocks.zh: 部分和完整的材料编码. 分享材料编码器并不意味着部分观测会产生完全物质潜伏物的相应一分. 我们用GT几何,相机,和复杂-Tex上的PBR值来隔离这种区分,绕过2D预测和流生成. 对于每个物体,我们用同一种被冷冻的编码器,用它的后座来编码完整的材料和被过滤的可见子集,然后用相同的被观测到的坐标来比较特性. 我们用每个信道固定的材料相对标准偏差来分出每个信道后,测量RMS在坐标和信道上的差异,并平均得出物体之间的分数。 我们保留通过坐标和投影检查的物体,不包括失败的投影-IoU检查或不相容的几何/材料支持. 所有被保留对象都有非零差异:平均标准化RMS为0.713(95%的对象-bootstrap间隔为0.684–0.742),中位数为0.680,而重复的相同输入编码给出了零差异(图4 a). 因此,部分编码甚至对于没有变化的输入材料也会改变表示.

blocks.en: Latent distance alone does not establish material degradation. We decode the preselected cases nearest the 10th, 50th, and 90th latent-difference percentiles with the same frozen decoder. Each arm retains its encoder’s spatial correspondence cache, so this tests material reconstruction on supplied geometry rather than autonomous recovery of surface support. Figure 4 b compares identical GT-selected crops; albedo PSNR is computed on the same retained GT surface voxels for both arms. Full/partial PSNR is 43.39/29.67, 40.68/26.52, and 27.41/24.37 dB for the cup, dartboard, and canister, respectively. Partial reconstructions retain the main patterns but introduce additional detail and color errors, including a pink shift in the dartboard’s white regions. The canister also shows appreciable full-input VAE error, which must be separated from the additional partial-input error. These three examples demonstrate decodable material content with imperfect fidelity; they are not a cohort-wide reconstruction estimate. Together, these results show that partial encoding supplies material evidence for refinement during full-surface generation. Appendix E.2 provides diagnostic settings.
blocks.zh: 仅靠近距离并不能确定物质降解。 我们用同样的冷冻解码器解码了10、50和90个潜在分解百分位数。 每个臂保留了编码器的空间通信缓存,因此这个测试是在所提供的几何上进行材料重建,而不是自主地恢复地表支持. 图4b比较了相同的GT选取作物;反照率PSNR是用两只手臂相同的保留GT地表花瓶计算的。 完全/部分PSNR分别为43.39/29.67,40.68/26.52和27.41/24.37 dB,分别用于杯子,飞镖板和罐子. 部分重建保留了主要图案,但引入了额外的细节和色彩错误,包括在飞镖板的白色区域进行粉色转变. 弹筒还显示明显的全输入 VAE 错误,必须从额外的部分输入错误中分离出. 这三个例子显示出可解码的物质内容不尽如人意;它们不是全群重建的估计。 这些结果表明,部分编码为在全地表生成过程中进行精细化提供了物证。 附录E.2提供诊断设置.

blocks.en: 5  Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 限制

blocks.en: Figure 5 shows how imperfect geometry, uncertain materials, and missing observations limit asset quality.
blocks.zh: 图5显示了不完善的几何,不确定的材料和缺失的观测如何限制资产质量.

blocks.en: Large image–geometry discrepancies. In end-to-end generation, SUPRA-Tex uses geometry predicted by Pixal3D ⋆ . Large discrepancies in shape or pose between the reference image and the mesh can place projected material observations on incorrect surface locations. Correspondence filtering removes some unreliable observations, but cannot correct the underlying geometry, which remains fixed during material generation. Severe discrepancies can therefore prevent faithful texture alignment. Improving upstream geometry and camera alignment is therefore an important direction, but we do not evaluate corrected-geometry controls here.
blocks.zh: 大图像- 几何差异 。 在端到端的生成中,SUPRA-Tex使用由Pixal3D QQ所预测的几何. 参考图像和网格在外观或外观上的巨大差异可以将预测的物质观测投放不正确的地表位置上. 函式过滤可以去除一些不可靠的观测,但无法纠正基础几何学,在材料生成过程中仍然固定. 因此,严重的差异可以阻止忠实的纹理相接。 因此,改进上游几何和相机对接是一个重要方向,但我们不评估校正几何控制。

blocks.en: Hallucinated geometry on unseen surfaces. Upstream geometry generators such as Pixal3D ⋆ can introduce implausible unseen structures even when the visible shape matches the reference. These structures may deviate from shapes learned by the material generator, hindering coherent texture completion. Since SUPRA-Tex conditions on fixed geometry, it cannot remove these structures; their influence on texture generation can reduce final asset quality.
blocks.zh: 在看不见的地表被幻化了几何 Pixal3D QQ等上游几何发生器即使可见外形与参考物相匹配,也可以引入不可信的隐形结构. 这些结构可能偏离了材料生成器所学的形状,阻碍了连贯的纹理完成. 由于SUPRA-Tex关于固定几何的条件,它不能去除这些结构;它们对纹理生成的影响会降低最终的资产质量.

blocks.en: Inconsistent completion across visibility boundaries. Completing unseen surfaces is particularly challenging when text or patterns extend beyond the visible region. For example, lettering that wraps around a can may be only partially visible in the input. The model may preserve the visible fragment yet fail to continue its strokes or layout coherently onto the hidden side, producing inconsistent text or patterns across the visibility boundary.
blocks.zh: 跨越能见度界限的不连贯完成. 当文字或图案超出可见区域时,完成看不见的表面尤其具有挑战性。 例如,环绕一个能的字母可能只在输入中部分可见. 该模型可能保留可见的碎片,但未能在隐藏的一面继续下划线或布局,从而产生跨越可见边界的不一致的文字或图案。

blocks.en: Errors in 2D material estimation. The 2D material estimator can misinterpret material properties, for example by assigning high metallic values to a non-metallic surface. These estimates condition the 3D generator, which may retain the error in the completed asset and produce implausible reflections under rendering or relighting. Accurate transfer of reference details thus does not guarantee correct material decomposition.
blocks.zh: 二维材料估计出错. 2D物质估计器可以错误地解释材料的特性,例如将高金属值分配给非金属表面。 这些估计使3D生成器有条件,3D生成器可能保留已完工资产中的出错,并在渲染或再光下产生不可信的反射. 因此,准确转让参考细节不能保证正确的材料分解。

blocks.en: Failure cases. Figure 5 illustrates these limitations. Reference fidelity depends on usable image–surface correspondence and reliable material observations, while fine detail on unseen surfaces must be generated. The plate shows a printed motif reconstructed as protruding geometry, and the sign retains spurious structures after texture refinement. The owl separates recognizable appearance details from an ambiguous reflectance estimate; the teapot separates sharp observed patterns from less precise unseen completion. These are qualitative cases, without corrected-geometry controls or measured unseen-surface ground truth. A back view may help the last case; we report no paired two-view result.

blocks.en: 6  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented SUPRA-Tex, a framework for single-image 3D generation with super-aligned textures through observation-guided material completion. By separating visible-material estimation and surface alignment from 3D generation and using native observation latents as fixed, read-only anchors, SUPRA-Tex preserves fine reference details while generating coherent, relightable materials across the full surface. Trained solely on public data, it achieves state-of-the-art results among the evaluated methods in geometry-conditioned texturing and end-to-end asset generation. With synthetic back-view conditioning, it is also competitive with commercial systems in human evaluations on the mixed real-and-synthetic comparison set. These results demonstrate the value of spatially aligned, directly usable material observations for reconciling reference fidelity with full-surface generation.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了SUPRA-Tex,这是通过观察制导材料完成,实现有超相通纹理的单像三维生成的框架. SUPRA-Tex通过将可见材料估计和地表对接与3D生成分离,并使用原生观测潜能作为固定的,只读锚地,保存了精细的参考细节,同时在整个地表产生连贯而可发光的材料. 它只接受公共数据培训,在几何质地定型和端到端资产生成方面,在评估方法中取得了最新成果。 在合成后视条件方面,它也与人类评价中的商业系统在真和合成混合比较集上具有竞争力。 这些结果表明,空间对齐、可直接使用的材料观测对调参考忠贞度与全地层生成的价值。

blocks.en: Inference-time boundary filtering. At inference, we additionally apply foreground-mask erosion and local depth-discontinuity filtering to reduce texture contamination from unreliable correspondences. Foreground erosion removes mixed pixels along the silhouette, and depth-discontinuity filtering rejects correspondences whose neighboring visible depths differ by more than a threshold, where a small projection error would move the observation onto a different surface. All material channels share the retained observation support, from which local material encoding, coverage, and boundary distance are computed.

The 2D material estimator is trained on paired RGB images, material maps, and normal maps rendered from Objaverse assets. blocks.en: B.2  Training F 2 ​ D F_{\mathrm{2D}}

blocks.en: We initialize F 2 ​ D F_{\mathrm{2D}} from FireRed-Image-Edit-1.1 adapted to individual PBR and normal prediction tasks, and jointly fine-tune it on aligned RGB images and ground-truth material and normal maps rendered from publicly available 3D assets. Both the task-specific adaptation and joint fine-tuning use these rendered data. Modality-axis attention is inserted at Transformer blocks 29, 39, 49, and 59, with rank 256 and four attention heads. We optimize these adapters and backbone blocks 29–49 using a latent flow-matching objective and AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) , with learning rates of 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} and 5 × 10 − 7 5\times 10^{-7} , respectively. The VAE and text encoder remain frozen.
blocks.zh: 我们从FireRed-Image-Edit-1.1中初始化适应个人PBR和正常预测任务的F 2 D → mathrm{2D},并联合根据一致的RGB图像和地面真实材料以及从公开的3D资产所提供正常地图进行微调. 具体任务的适应和联合微调都使用这些数据。 在变形器区块29,39,49和59处插入了模态轴注意力,并有256级和4个注意力头. 我们利用潜在流配对目标和AdamW(Lohchilov和Hutter, 2019年)来优化这些适配器和主干板块29–49, 学习率分别为2×10−4 2. VAE和文本编码器仍然被冻结.

blocks.en: By folding the batch dimension, the model processes albedo, metallic-roughness, and an auxiliary normal stream in parallel, inserting lightweight cross-attention adapters at specific transformer layers to exchange features across modality axes at identical spatial coordinates. We train F 2 ​ D F_{\mathrm{2D}} with a flow-matching objective anchored at the fixed maximum-noise endpoint σ = 1.0 \sigma=1.0 using an outlier-masked MSE loss. Elementwise latent-flow residuals with absolute magnitude greater than 50 contribute zero loss but remain in the averaging denominator. Losses are averaged equally across the albedo, metallic-roughness, and normal streams. At inference, we use a single prediction at this endpoint to estimate the clean material latents, which the image VAE decodes into 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 PBR maps.

blocks.en: B.3  3D Generator Training

blocks.en: Preprocessing for training. We build training observations from ground-truth PBR materials of public 3D assets using the visible-surface observation encoding pipeline. Foreground validity and first-hit visibility determine the observed surface voxels supplied to the sparse material encoder. We follow Pixal3D ( Li et al., 2026a ) for asset preprocessing and reference-view sampling. During training, we drop the entire observation condition with probability 0.03 0.03 while retaining the geometry condition.

blocks.en: C.2  Rendering and Metrics
blocks.zh: C.2 制作和计量

blocks.en: Protocol. Both settings evaluate the PBR asset each method exports, rendered under a shared protocol rather than compared in UV space, because latent decoding or remeshing changes the face layout. Predicted and ground-truth assets are rendered with the same cameras and forward lighting at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 and downsampled to 512 × 512 512\times 512 with Lanczos interpolation; methods whose output lives in another coordinate frame are brought into the evaluation frame by their own transform or, where marked † \dagger , by a similarity transform to the ground-truth mesh. Per-view metrics are PSNR, SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) , and VGG-LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) over the full image with a black background, so they penalize errors in silhouette as well as appearance, and CLIP-I, the cosine similarity of CLIP ViT-L/14 features ( Radford et al., 2021 ) between corresponding views. We additionally report PSNR fg on both shaded RGB and albedo, the same PSNR restricted to the ground-truth object mask, so that large black background regions do not dominate the score. Distribution metrics compare multi-view image sets within each dataset: FD DINOv3 uses 1024-dimensional DINOv3 ViT-L/16 CLS features ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) . In end-to-end evaluation, FID ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) uses Inception-v3 features, while FD CLIP and CMMD ( Jayasumana et al., 2024 ) provide additional distribution measures. For methods that output PBR, we report mean absolute error (MAE) of metallic and roughness over the intersection of the predicted and ground-truth object masks. Per-view metrics are averaged over views per object, then over valid objects. We report results separately on DTC-Tex and Complex-Tex. In the given-geometry setting, the mesh and camera are provided as ground truth; end-to-end generation predicts geometry, aligned to GT by a similarity transform only for scoring.
blocks.zh: 议定书。 这两个设置都评价了在共享协议下而不是在紫外空间中进行比较的PBR每种方法导出的资产,因为潜在的解码或重制会改变面部布局. 在1024×1024 1024\times 1024和下标为512×512\times 512的Lanczos插值时,用同样的相机和前向照明提供预定和地面实况资产;其产出寿命在另一个坐标框中的方法,通过自己的变换或标记为 \dangger 的方法,通过与地面实况网的相似性转换而进入评价框架。 Per-view的度量衡有:PSNR,SSIM (Wang等,2004年)和VGG-LPIPS (Zhang等,2018年) 在黑色背景的全图像上,它们惩罚了光线和外观上的错误,而CLIP-I,CLIP VIT-L/14特征的同位素相似性(Radford等,2021年)在相应观点上. 我们额外报告 PSNR fg 无论是阴影的 RGB 和反照率, 相同的 PSNR 仅限于地面真实对象口罩, 这样大的黑色背景区域不会主导分数. 分布度量衡比较了每个数据集内的多视图图像集:FD DINov3使用1024维的DINov3 VIT-L/16 CLS特征(Siméoni等,2025年). 在端到端评价中,FID(Heusel等,2017年)采用了Inception-v3特性,而FD CLIP和CMMD(Jayasumana等,2024年)则提供了额外的分发措施. 对于输出PBR的方法,我们报告指金属和粗糙度在预测和地面真实物体口罩相交处的绝对错误。 每处视图的衡量尺度是相对于每个物体的视图,然后是相对于有效物体的平均值。 我们分别报告关于DTC-Tex和Complex-Tex的结果。 在给定的几何设定中,网格和相机作为地真提供;端到端的生成预测几何,通过相似性转换来与GT对接,仅为分数.

blocks.en: Rendering cameras and alignment. For given-geometry evaluation, we replay the 16 camera poses and front-light settings stored in each ground-truth asset’s transforms.json ; the designated input camera defines the reference view, and the other 15 cameras define novel views. Ground-truth and predicted assets use identical cameras and lighting, rendered with Blender 3.0.1 and Filmic color management. Where geometric alignment is required, we use iterative closest point (ICP) and silhouette-based refinement to estimate a similarity transform to the ground-truth geometry before rendering. This alignment is used only for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 渲染相机和对齐. 对于给定的几何评价,我们重放存储在每个地真相资产转换中的16个相机姿势和前灯设置。 json;指定的输入相机定义了参考视图,而其他15个相机则定义了新颖视图. 地面真相和预测资产使用相同的相机和照明,配有Blender 3.0.1和Filmic色彩管理。 在需要几何对接的地方,我们使用迭接最近点(ICP)和以硅胶为基的改进来估计在渲染前与地-真几何的相似性转换. 这种校正只用于评价。

blocks.en: DINOv3 Fréchet distance for given-geometry texturing. For Table 1 , we extract the 1024-dimensional final-layer CLS token of DINOv3 ViT-L/16 without additional ℓ 2 \ell_{2} normalization. We alpha-composite each shaded rendering onto black, resize its shorter side to 256 pixels using bilinear interpolation, center-crop to 224 × 224 224\times 224 , and apply ImageNet mean and standard-deviation normalization. These features are computed in FP32 with TF32 disabled using Transformers 4.57.3. We compute the Fréchet distance between the feature means and unbiased covariances of the generated and corresponding ground-truth image sets, using float64 statistics. This is one set-level score per method and dataset, rather than an average of object-level distances.
blocks.zh: DINOv3 Fréchet 距离用于给定的几何纹理. 对于表1,我们提取了DINOv3 VIT-L/16的1024维的终极CLS符号,而无需额外的l 2\ell\2}正常化。 我们alpha-composite 每一个阴影渲染到黑色上, 使用双线插值将其较短的一面缩放到256像素上, 中间收缩到 224 × 224\times 224, 并应用 ImageNet 平均值和标准调试正常化 。 这些特性在FP32中被计算出,TF32被禁用,使用变形器4.57.3. 我们利用浮点64统计数据,计算Fréchet特性之间的距离,意味着生成的和相应的地面真实图像集的不偏倚共性。 这是每个方法和数据集一个设定等级分数,而不是对象等级相距的平均值.

blocks.en: C.3  Open-Source Baselines
blocks.zh: C.3 开源基线

blocks.en:
Given-geometry comparison. Each object provides a ground-truth mesh and a forward-lit reference image from a specified view; every method textures the ground-truth mesh from this image through its own interface, and we render 16 views comprising the reference view and 15 novel views. We compare against the texturing stages of the native 3D generators TRELLIS.2 and Pixal3D ⋆ and of the pipelines Hunyuan3D 2.1 and Step1X-3D ( Xiang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Tencent Hunyuan3D Team, 2025b ; Li et al., 2025a ) , and against the dedicated texturing methods LumiTex, MVPainter, MV-Adapter, TEXGen, UniTEX, and Ink3D ( Bao et al., 2026 ; Shao et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025b ; Yu et al., 2024 ; Liang et al., 2026 ; Han et al., 2026 ) . TRELLIS.2, Pixal3D ⋆ , Hunyuan3D 2.1, LumiTex, and MVPainter output PBR materials and are evaluated on shaded renderings, albedo, metallic, and roughness; the remaining methods output RGB textures and are evaluated on shaded renderings only, with unavailable channels marked “–”.
We use the official implementations and released checkpoints for all baselines, providing the reference camera to every method that supports camera conditioning.

给定几何比较. 每个对象从指定的视图中提供地真网和前置的参考图像;每一种方法都通过自己的界面从这个图像中纹理地真网,我们提出16个观点,包括参考视图和15个新观点. 我们比较了原生3D发电机TRELLIS.2和Pixal3D ⋆和输油管Hunyuan3D 2.1和Step1X-3D(Xiang等,2026;Li等,2026a;Tencent Hunyuan3D)的发纹阶段。 Team,2025b;Li等,2025a;Liang等,2026;Han等,2026;TRELLIS.2;Pixal3D-⋆;Hunyuan3D 2.1;LumiTex;和MVPAinter输出PBR材料,对Bao等,2026;Shao等,2025;Huang等,2025b;Yu等,2024;Liang等,2026;TRELLIS.2;Pixal3D-⋆;Hunyuan3D 2.1;LumiTex;和MVPAinter输出PBR材料进行评估,并按阴影渲染、反照度、金属和粗糙度对其余方法进行评估;仅对阴影渲染物进行评估,标有 " - " 。
我们对所有基线都使用正式实施并放出检查站,为支持相机调节的每一种方法提供参考相机.

blocks.en: End-to-end comparison. When geometry is also predicted, reference fidelity depends on geometry reconstruction, surface correspondence, and material generation together. This is the setting the observation interface is most exposed to: the anchors now land on a predicted mesh through a predicted camera, so any geometry or correspondence error propagates into the materials. Each method takes the reference image alone. Pixal3D ⋆ and SUPRA-Tex share the same predicted geometry and apply their respective appearance-generation pipelines; the other baselines use their own geometry-generation pipelines. SUPRA-Tex textures this predicted mesh with the pipeline of Sec. 3.5 . We compare with TRELLIS.2, Pixal3D ⋆ , Hunyuan3D 2.1, Step1X-3D, UniLat3D, and CUPID ( Xiang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Tencent Hunyuan3D Team, 2025b ; Li et al., 2025a ; Wu et al., 2026a ; Huang et al., 2026 ) , covering native latent generation, staged geometry-then-texture pipelines, and joint object–pose modeling. Since output material attributes differ across these systems, we compare complete assets through rendered appearance only. For scoring, outputs are brought into a common coordinate frame using their coordinate transforms or, for methods marked † \dagger , similarity alignment to the ground truth; this alignment plays no role in generation.
blocks.zh: 端相相比较. 当也预测出几何时,参考忠心度取决于几何重建,地表相通,以及物质生成一起. 这就是观测界面最暴露的设置: 锚现在通过一个预测相机降落在预测的网状上, 所以任何几何或通信错误都会传播到材料中。 每种方法都只取参考图像. Pixal3D QQ和SUPRA-Tex共享相同的预测几何并应用了各自的外观生成管;其他基线使用自己的几何生成管. SUPRA-Tex纹理 预想的网格 与管道Sec. 3.5。 我们与TRELLIS.2、Pixal3D ⋆、Hunyuan3D 2.1、Step1X-3D、UniLat3D和CUPID(Xiang等,2026;Li等,2026a;Tencent Hunyuan3D)进行比较。 Team,2025b;Li等人,2025a;Wu等人,2026a; Huang等,2026年),涵盖本土潜生,相接相接的几何-当时的纹理管道,以及相接的物体-拥有模型. 由于这些系统中产出材料属性不同,我们只通过外观来比较完整的资产。 评分方面,输出通过坐标变换,或者,对于标有 \ dagger 的方法,与地面真理的相似性调和,被带入一个共同的坐标框架;这种调和在生成时没有作用.

blocks.en: Reconstruction metrics take the reference view as anchor and compare four rendered views against the ground truth: the reference direction, its two sides, and the back. The side and back views thus test the completed surface, not only the reference view. CLIP-I compares the reference-view rendering with the input image. FD DINOv3 , FD CLIP , FID, and CMMD compare the set of 16 rendered views of generated assets with the corresponding ground-truth set within each dataset. Reconstruction and CLIP-I measure fidelity to a specific object; the distribution metrics measure the visual quality of the generated population.
blocks.zh: 重建的衡量标准以参考观点为依托,并比较了与地面真相相反的四种观点:参考方向、其两面和背面。 侧面和背面的视图从而检验已完成的地表,而不仅仅是参考视图. CLIP-I比较了参考视图渲染和输入图像. FD DINOv3、FD CLIP、FID和CMMD将16种生成资产的意见与每个数据集内相应的地面实况集进行比较。 重建与CLIP-I度量对特定对象的忠诚度;分布度量度量所生成人群的视觉质量.

blocks.en: Baselines. We use the authors’ released checkpoints and implementations for the open-source baselines, following their inference recipes with method-specific sampling, resolution, and texture-export settings. Integration includes input-format conversion and repairs to mesh preprocessing, UV construction, and export. For given-geometry texturing, each method receives the designated reference image and GT mesh with its original materials removed, using the method’s texturing interface; the reference camera is supplied where the interface supports it. No GT material maps or additional GT images are provided. For image-to-3D generation, each method receives the same single reference image. Pixal3D ⋆ and SUPRA-Tex share predicted geometry, as specified in Sec. 4.2 .
blocks.zh: 基线。 我们使用作者释放的检查站和实施开源基线,遵循他们根据特定方法的取样、分辨率和纹理出口设置所作的推论。 集成包括输入-格式转换和网格预处理的修复,紫外线建造,以及导出. 对于给定的几何纹理,每种方法都接收指定的参考图像和GT网,并取出其原始材料,使用方法的纹理接口;在接口支持它的地方提供参考相机. 不提供GT材料地图或额外的GT图像. 对于图像到3D生成,每种方法都得到相同的单一参考图像. Pixal3D QQ和 SUPRA-Tex 共享预测几何,详见 Sec.4.2.

blocks.en: Exported assets are converted from their method-specific coordinate frames for evaluation; similarity alignment is applied where indicated by † \dagger in the tables. Rendering and scoring follow the shared evaluation protocol. TEXTRIX ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) was not included in the quantitative comparison because its official implementation and pretrained weights were unavailable when our experiments were conducted. The same availability constraint applied to NaTex, LaFiTe, and MatMart ( Lai et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026b ) . We discuss these methods in Sec. 2 , but do not mix their reported scores with our results because the datasets and evaluation protocols differ.
blocks.zh: 出口资产按其特定方法的坐标框架进行转换,用于评价;如果\\dagger在表格中表示,则采用相似度对齐。 制作和评分遵循共享评价协议。 TEXTRIX(Zeng等人,2026年)没有列入定量比较,因为当我们进行实验时,其正式实施和预受训练的权重都不存在. NaTex、LaFiTe和MatMart也受到同样的供应限制(Lai等,2026;Chen等,2026;Wu等,2026b)。 我们在第2节中讨论这些方法,但不要把报告得分与我们的结果混为一谈,因为数据集和评价协议不同。

blocks.en: C.4  Commercial Comparisons
blocks.zh: C.4 商业比较

blocks.en: Commercial systems do not disclose their training data, so overlap with our ground-truth benchmarks cannot be ruled out. We therefore evaluate SUPRA-Tex without additional fine-tuning on a separate set of 45 images, comprising real photographs sourced online or contributed by users and synthetic images generated by image generation models such as GPT-Image-2. We compare end-to-end with the five commercial systems in Table 5 : Hunyuan3D (v3.1), Hyper3D (Rodin-2.5 Extremely High), Tripo (H3.1), Meshy (v7.1), and Hi3D (v3.0), using their most advanced configurations and accessed after September 24, 2026. Hyper3D is listed as Rodin in the table.
blocks.zh: 商业系统不披露其培训数据,因此不能排除与我们地面实况基准的重叠。 因此,我们评价SUPRA-Tex,而不对单独的一套45个图像进行额外的微调,这些图像包括在线来源或用户提供的真实照片以及GPT-Image-2等图像生成模型产生的合成图像。 我们用最先进的配置与2026年9月24日之后访问的Hunyuan3D(v3.1),Hyper3D(Rodin-2.5 Extreme High),Tripo(H31),Messy(v7.1)和Hi3D(v3.0)等5个商业系统进行比较. Hyper3D在表中被列为Rodin.

blocks.en: We use two-view conditioning only for commercial comparisons, combining the reference image with a back view synthesized from it through the interface in Appendix G.1 . We submit only the original reference image to each commercial system. Auxiliary-view synthesis is also supported by commercial workflows such as Meshy’s multi-view mode, which can generate missing views from a single image ( Zoey, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们只为商业比较使用双视图条件,将参考图像与通过附录G.1中的接口从中合成的后视图相合并。 我们只提交每个商业系统的原始参考图像。 辅景-取景合成也得到Messy多取景模式等商业工作流程的支持,可生成单个图像的缺失视图(Zoey, 2026).

blocks.en: The 3D generator receives projected PBR observations rather than photographs, so generalization to real inputs depends on the fine-tuned 2D material estimator and accurate placement of the surface observations. In the absence of ground-truth geometry and cameras, paired reconstruction metrics are unavailable. We instead assess three criteria: alignment with the input image, including text, logos, and color layout; PBR plausibility; and overall visual quality.
blocks.zh: 3D生成器接收了预测的PBR观测结果而不是相片,因此,对真实输入的概括取决于微调的2D物质估计器和准确的地表观测位置. 由于缺乏地貌几何和相机,没有配对的重建指标。 相反,我们评估三个标准:与输入图像保持一致,包括文本、标志和颜色布局;PBR可信度;以及整体视觉质量。

blocks.en: We collected 512 valid pairwise evaluations, each comprising one participant’s judgments on all three criteria for SUPRA-Tex versus one commercial system on a given input case. Each participant evaluated at most one model pair per case. For each of the five commercial systems and each criterion, Table 5 reports SUPRA-Tex’s wins divided by the total number of non-tied votes, pooled across evaluations.
blocks.zh: 我们收集了512个有效的对等评价,每个评价包括一名参与者对SUPRA-Tex的所有三项标准所作的判断,对某一特定输入案例的一个商业系统所作的判断。 每个参与者对每个案件最多一个模型对进行了评价。 对于五个商业系统和每个标准,表5报告SUPRA-Tex的得分,除以所有评价的非连带选票总数。

blocks.en: Qwen3.8-27B assigns each result a score from 0 to 10 using the rendered outputs. Table 5 reports both human preferences and VLM ratings. Figure 3 shows how SUPRA-Tex preserves reference details and coherently completes unseen surfaces using only public training data.
blocks.zh: Quen3.8-27 (中文(简体) ). B利用所提供的产出给每个结果分配从0到10的分数。 表5汇报了人类喜好和VLM的评级。 图3显示SUPRA-Tex如何保存参考细节并统一完成仅使用公共培训数据的未见表面。

blocks.en: Appendix D 2D Material Evaluation
blocks.zh: 附录D 2D 材料评价

blocks.en: D.1  2D Material Prediction
blocks.zh: D.1 二维材料预测

blocks.en: We evaluate F 2 ​ D F_{\mathrm{2D}} directly in image space, before 3D projection, sparse encoding, or completion. The evaluation includes all 100 objects of DTC-Tex and all 110 objects of Complex-Tex, using each object’s designated reference view. Predictions use one deterministic step at native 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 resolution, CFG 1, and seed 42. All 210 cases complete successfully, with no exclusions. The auxiliary normal output is generated but is not scored here.
blocks.zh: 我们直接在图像空间中评价F 2 D → mathrm{2D}, 在3D投影, 零散编码, 或完成之前。 该评价包括DTC-Tex的所有100个对象和Complex-Tex的所有110个对象,使用每个对象的指定参考视图. 预测在本地的1024×1024 1024\times 1024分辨率,CFG 1和种子 42. 所有210个案件都顺利完成,没有排除。 辅助的正态输出是生成的, 但在此没有得分 。

blocks.en: Targets and metric domains. We reuse the benchmark’s existing reference-view PNG targets without resizing or inverse display/gamma conversion. Each image is independently composited onto black using its own alpha, when present. Albedo PSNR and albedo, metallic, and roughness MAE use the GT foreground ( α > 0.5 \alpha>0.5 ). Albedo full-image PSNR uses the mean squared error over all RGB pixels with unit data range. Albedo SSIM uses the full image with a 7 × 7 7\times 7 window and unit data range; VGG-LPIPS also uses the full image. None of the full-image metrics masks prediction pixels with the GT foreground. Metallic and roughness predictions are read from the red and green channels of the MRA output. Metrics are computed per object and averaged separately within each dataset.
blocks.zh: 目标和衡量领域。 我们重新使用基准的现有参考视图PNG目标,而不调整大小或反向显示/伽马转换。 每个图像在出现时使用自己的α被独立合成成黑色. Albedo PSNR和反照率、金属和粗糙度MAE使用GT前景(α > 0.5\alpha>0.5)。 Albedo full-image PSNR 对所有具有单位数据范围的 RGB 像素使用平均平方误差. Albedo SSIM使用全图像,并有7×7 7\times 7窗口和单位数据范围;VGG-LPIPS也使用全图像. 完全图像的度量衡都没有用GT前景来遮掩预测像素. 金属和粗糙度预测从MRA输出的红色和绿色通道读取. 计量按对象计算,并在每个数据集内分别平均值.

blocks.en: Metrics are computed in the stored PNG encoding; metallic and roughness MAE therefore measure encoded-value differences rather than physical-linear material error.
blocks.zh: 计量在所储存的PNG编码中计算;因此,金属和粗糙度MAE测量编码值差异,而不是物理线性物质误差。

blocks.zh: 表8:独立的二维材料预测. 度量衡在基准PNG代码域的物体上平均;金属和粗糙度MAE不测量物理线性错误.

blocks.en: Results. The measured foreground PSNR is approximately 19–20 dB, so these results do not establish near-ground-truth observation accuracy. Full-image PSNR is 28.25 and 28.19 dB on DTC-Tex and Complex-Tex, respectively. Like full-image SSIM and LPIPS, it includes the shared background and should be interpreted separately from foreground PSNR. This experiment measures standalone F 2 ​ D F_{\mathrm{2D}} ; the effect of its errors on 3D generation is compared in Sec. 4.4 , with settings provided in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 结果。 所测前地PSNR约为19–20分贝,因此这些结果不能确定近地-真实观测的准确性. 全相PSNR在DTC-Tex和Complex-Tex上分别为28.25和28.19 dB. 和全图像的SSIM和LPIPS一样,它包括了共享的背景,应该与前景PSNR分开来解释. 这一实验措施是独立的F 2 D → MAThrm{2D};其出错对3D生成的影响在Sec.4.4中比较,设置在附录E中提供.

blocks.en: D.2 F 2 ​ D F_{\mathrm{2D}} Runtime
blocks.zh: D.2 F 2 D-Mathrm{2D}} 运行时间

blocks.en: Each request runs on one NVIDIA H800. After two warmup calls per worker, synchronized wall time covers input loading, conditioning, the single DiT call, and VAE/PIL decoding; model initialization and PNG writing are excluded. The mean isolated DiT latency is 1.205 s on both datasets, and peak allocated memory is 66.25 GiB. Four independent workers produce the cohort, with one GPU per request.
blocks.zh: 每项请求都使用1个NVIDIA H800。 每名工人两次取暖后,同步墙上时间覆盖了输入加载,调制,单DiT调用,以及VAE/PIL解码;模型初始化和PNG写作被排除在外. 平均隔离的DiT latency在两个数据集上为 1.205 s,而峰值分配内存为 66.25 GiB. 四名独立工人生产这批人,每个要求一个GPU。

blocks.en: Repeated DiT forward timing. We additionally measure the single DiT forward pass with the model loaded once and kept resident on one NVIDIA H800. After 10 excluded warmup calls, we time 30 repetitions of one reference image and 30 calls cycling through six reference images (three each from DTC-Tex and Complex-Tex). CUDA-event mean forward times are 1.1990 s and 1.1987 s, respectively, rounded to 1.20 s in the main text. Each call jointly predicts albedo, metallic–roughness, and normal outputs at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 with BF16, one inference step, CFG 1, and seed 42. Timing covers only the DiT forward pass, excluding model loading, conditioning, VAE encoding/decoding, and file I/O.
blocks.zh: 重复的 DiT 前行时间 。 我们用装入过一次的车型测量单个DiT前传,并一直停留在一台NVIDIA H800上. 在10个排除了取暖调用后,我们用30个时间重复一个参考图像,30个调用通过6个参考图像循环(DTC-Tex和Complex-Tex各3个). CUDA-event指向前去的时间分别为1.1990 s和1.1987 s,在正文中四舍五入为1.20 s. 每一次呼叫都以BF16,一个推论步骤CFG 1和种子42来共同预测反照率,金属-粗糙度和正常输出. 计时只覆盖了DiT前传,不包括模型加载,调制,VAE编码/解码,以及文件 I/O.

blocks.en: E.1  Ablation Configurations
blocks.zh: E.1 读取配置

blocks.en: What observations carry. The material-content comparison retains predicted albedo and replaces only metallic and roughness with fixed or dataset-mean constants. Ours uses all predicted PBR channels. Oracle PBR replaces the local observations with GT materials and is reported separately as a material-quality reference. The standalone image-space accuracy of F 2 ​ D F_{\mathrm{2D}} is reported in Appendix D.1 .
blocks.zh: 观察的内容是什么? 材料内容比较保留了预测的反照率,只用固定或数据集-正数取而代之的是金属和粗糙度。 我们使用所有的预测的PBR频道. Oracle PBR用GT材料来取而代之地观测,并作为材料质量的参考单独报告. 附录D.1中报告了F 2 D → matherm{2D}的独立图像-空间精度。

blocks.en: E.2  Partial and Complete Encoding: Diagnostic Protocol
blocks.zh: E.2 部分和完整的编码:诊断规程

blocks.en: The results and reconstruction examples appear in Sec. 4.4 .
blocks.zh: 结果和重建的例子见第4.4节。

blocks.en: Diagnostic protocol. Figure 4 reports the paired GT partial-versus-complete encoding analysis and three illustrative material reconstructions. The diagnostic uses each object’s designated reference view, a two-pixel foreground erosion, and a 3 × 3 3\times 3 depth-discontinuity filter with relative threshold 0.04; projection IoU must be at least 0.90. The latent summary weights objects equally and uses 10,000 object-bootstrap resamples. The decoded examples are the objects nearest the 10th, 50th, and 90th percentiles of object-level latent RMS. Their 128 × 128 128\times 128 crops maximize GT albedo gradient on a 16-pixel candidate grid with at least 80% valid pixels. Material values are converted to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] and clamped as in the production decoder path; PSNR uses the same retained GT surface voxels for both reconstructions. Geometry support is supplied by each encoder’s spatial correspondence cache, so coordinate coverage is not evidence of independent geometry recovery.
blocks.zh: 诊断程序。 图4报告了GT部分与完整的编码分析和三个说明材料重建。 诊断使用每个物体的指定参考视图,双像素前地侵蚀,并使用3×3 3\times 3深度-断裂滤波器,相对阈值为0.04;投影IoU必须至少为0.90. 潜在即时加权物体相等,并使用一万个物体-bootstrap resamples。 已解码的示例是距离对象级潜在RMS的第10个、第50个和第90个百分位数最近的对象。 他们的128×128 128\times 128作物在至少80%有效像素的16像素候选网格上使GT反照率梯度最大化. 材料值被转换为 [0, 1] [0, 1] 并像生产解码道一样被夹住;PSNR对两种重建都使用相同的所保留的GT表面活塞. 几何学支持由每个编码器的空间通信缓存提供,因此坐标覆盖不是独立几何学恢复的证据.

blocks.en: E.3  Observed-Support Encoding versus Zero Filling
blocks.zh: E.3 观察-支持编码与零填充

blocks.en: As discussed in Sec. 3.3 , zero-padding unobserved regions assigns the missing values concrete material semantics, such as black albedo. In the zero-filled formulation, we observed a pronounced dark bias on unseen surfaces. Figure 8 illustrates this behavior: the back of the calculator becomes nearly black and retains spurious front-side characters, while the dish develops dark mottling on its red side and white underside. With observed-support-only encoding, SUPRA-Tex instead produces a green calculator back and preserves the dish’s red-and-white color regions.

The calculator and dish are shown with their input images, followed by shaded and albedo renderings from the zero-filled model and SUPRA-Tex. The zero-filled results darken the unseen surfaces; SUPRA-Tex retains the corresponding green and red-and-white materials. Each comparison uses the same geometry and perspective view.

blocks.en: E.4  Early Learning with Native PBR Latents
blocks.zh: E.4 早期学习土著PBR梯队

blocks.en: The native PBR latent is an in-domain observation representation: visible material evidence is encoded by the same pretrained material VAE that defines the generator’s output space. We examine how quickly the generator learns to recover reference-view appearance from this representation, using the official Pixal3D ⋆ ( Li et al., 2026a ) implementation as an image-feature-conditioned comparison.
blocks.zh: 本地 PBR 潜入是域内观测的表示:可见的物证由定义生成器输出空间的同一种预受训练的材料 VAE 编码. 我们研究生成器如何迅速地从这个代表中恢复参考视图的外观,使用官方的Pixal3D QQ(Li等,2026a)执行作为图像定型的比较.

blocks.en: Both models are trained on the same training set and initialized from the same pretrained TRELLIS.2 denoiser with their respective architectural adaptations and fresh optimizers. TeaPot is used only for evaluation, not for single-object fitting. We evaluate all 16 raw checkpoints from step 0 to 1500 at intervals of 100 on its designated front view; there are no failed or excluded checkpoints. Our model receives ground-truth albedo, metallic, roughness, and opacity through native partial-material encoding, while Pixal3D ⋆ receives the corresponding front-lit RGB image through its official image-feature projection interface. This oracle-material setting examines the 3D model’s ability to learn from native observations independently of F 2 ​ D F_{\mathrm{2D}} prediction errors. The two conditioning designs retain their respective architectures and optimization recipes.
blocks.zh: 两个型号都接受了相同的培训,并且从同一预训的TRELLIS.2 denoiser中以各自的建筑改造和新鲜优化器进行初始化. TeaPot只用于评价,不用于单个对象的装配. 我们评估从第0步到第1500步的所有16个原始检查站,每隔100个检查站就在其指定的前方视线上;没有失效或被排除在外的检查站。 我们的模型通过原生部分材料编码接收地真反照率,金属,粗糙度和不透明度,而Pixal3D QQ则通过它的官方图像-地性投影界面接收相应的前置RGB图像. 这种甲骨文-材料设置检查了3D模型独立于F 2 D → mathrm{2D} 预测错误而从本土观测中学习的能力. 两种调制设计保留了各自的架构和优化配方.

blocks.en: Figure 9: Early reference-view learning on TeaPot during full-data training. Ours uses GT PBR observations; Pixal3D ⋆ uses the corresponding shaded RGB image. Each point is an evaluated checkpoint. Most of our model’s improvement occurs within the first 300 steps.
blocks.zh: 图 9:在全面数据培训期间对TeaPot进行早期参考-观点学习. Ours使用GT PBR观测; Pixal3D QQ使用相应的阴影RGB图像. 每个点都是经过评估的检查站。 我们模式的大多数改进都发生在前300个步骤中。

blocks.en: All checkpoints use the same GT geometry and camera, 25 Euler sampling steps, seed 42, and time rescaling factor 3, with no reprojection repainting or material postprocessing. We render with Blender 3.0.1 using Filmic color management and 32 samples at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 , then resize to 512 × 512 512\times 512 with Lanczos for scoring. Foreground PSNR uses the same 31,016 GT-mask pixels without erosion or intersection with the prediction mask. SSIM and VGG-LPIPS use the full image, including the background.
blocks.zh: 所有检查站都使用相同的GT几何和相机、25个欧勒取样步骤、42个种子和时间调整因子3,没有再投影再油漆或材料后处理。 我们使用 Blender 3.0.1 使用 Filmic 彩色管理 和 32 个样本, 在 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 时, 然后调整为 512 × 512 512\times 512 与 Lanczos 进行打分 。 前景PSNR使用相同的31,016个GT-mask像素而不受侵蚀或与预测口罩相接. SSIM和VGG-LPIPS使用完整图像,包括背景.

blocks.en: With GT PBR observations, our model reaches 29.46 dB shaded foreground PSNR on the TeaPot reference view after 300 steps, compared with 18.72 dB for Pixal3D ⋆ under shaded RGB conditioning. At step 1500, the scores are 30.86 versus 20.89 dB, SSIM is 0.9938 versus 0.9557, and LPIPS is 0.00436 versus 0.03996. Figure 10 shows the early recovery of reference colors and floral patterns. This single-view diagnostic supports the learnability of native observations under oracle-material conditioning; it does not isolate conditioning from the models’ architectural and optimization differences. Full-surface and dataset-level quality are evaluated separately in the main experiments.
blocks.zh: 通过GT PBR的观测,我们的模型在Teapot参考视图上经过了300个步骤后达到了29.46 dB阴影前缘PSNR,相比之下,在阴影下RGB调制下,Pixal3D QQ为18.72 dB. 1500步,分数为30.86分对20.89分B,SSIM为0.9938分对0.9557分,LPIPS为0.00436分对0.03996分. 图10显示了参考颜色和花卉形态的早期恢复. 这种单视诊断支持在甲骨文-材料条件下本体观测的可学习性;它不会将条件与模型的建筑和优化差异隔离开来. 在主要实验中,对全地表质量和数据集质量分别进行评估。

blocks.en: G.1  Single-View Generation and Back-View Editing
blocks.zh: G.1 单视生成和后视编辑

blocks.en: Because any image attached to the surface becomes an anchor (Sec. 3.3 ), the same generator accepts a second view or an edited view without retraining: a 2D editing model can supply appearance for surfaces the reference never shows, or change the appearance of surfaces it does. Both put the unseen surface under user control: the single-view results of Secs. 4.1 and 4.2 show what the generator completes on its own, and the extensions show what it produces when instructed. We demonstrate both with the same 3D generator and no additional 3D training.
blocks.zh: 因为任何附着于表面的图像会变成锚(Sec. 3.3),所以同一生成器会接受第二个视图或编辑后视图而不进行再培训:一个2D编辑模型可以为参考物从未显示的表面提供外观,或者改变表面的外观,它会这样做. 两者都将看不见的表面置于用户控制之下:Secs 4.1和4.2的单视图结果显示生成器自行完成什么,扩展则显示它指示时产生什么. 我们用同样的三维发电机演示 并且没有额外的三维训练

blocks.en: Synthetic back-view conditions. From the same reference photograph, we synthesize a geometry-consistent back view and encode it as an additional material condition. Specifically, we select a viewpoint with minimal visual overlap relative to the reference, typically the opposite back side, render its surface normal map, and synthesize its shaded appearance via an MLLM, such as GPT-image, guided by the reference image, the rendered normal map, and optional user prompts. Both shaded views are translated into PBR maps, aggregated in 3D coordinate space via projection, and encoded into unified anchors O O for full-surface completion. We use this two-view variant for comparisons with commercial systems; the benchmark comparisons in Tables 1 and 3 use the single-view model.
blocks.zh: 合成后视条件. 从同一张参考相片中,我们合成了几何相容的后视并编码为附加的物质条件. 具体地说,我们选择一个相对于参考物的视觉相重叠最小的视角,一般是反向后侧,使其表面正常地映射,并通过一个MLLLM来合成其阴影外观,比如GPT-image,以参考物图像为引导,渲染出正常地映射,以及可选的用户提示. 两个阴影视图被翻译为PBR地图,通过投影被聚合为3D坐标空间,并被编码为统一锚地O O以完成全地表完成. 我们使用这个双视图变量与商业系统进行比较;表1和表3中的基准比较使用单视图模型.

blocks.en: Texture editing. Editing the observation condition transfers image edits to the 3D surface. We use the image editing model to modify the front or back view, rebuild that view’s observations, and regenerate the complete material. The visualizations show how the requested edit appears on the corresponding surface and how the edited region stays consistent with the rest of the asset.
blocks.zh: 纹理编辑. 编辑观测条件将图像编辑转移到3D表面。 我们使用图像编辑模型来修改前视图或后视图,重建该视图的观测,并再现完整的材料. 可视化显示请求的编辑出现在相应的表面,编辑区域如何与资产的其他部分保持一致.

blocks.en: Porcelain-plate example. Figure 13 demonstrates single-view generation, two-view fusion, and image-space material editing on a porcelain plate. Starting from the same front photograph and source geometry, the single-view model completes the unobserved back. A geometry-guided 2D design supplies a second material observation; editing that design produces crane-and-peony, geometric, and koi variants without additional 3D training. The synthetic back is a design hypothesis rather than a second photograph of the real object.
blocks.zh: 取出瓷板作譬. 图13显示了单视生成,双视聚变,以及一瓷板上图像空间材料的编辑. 从同一张前相和源几何开始,单视模型完成无观测回回. 一个几何制导的2D设计提供了第二次材料观测;这种设计的编辑可以产生起重机-和-peony,几何,和koi等变体而无需额外的3D训练. 合成后背是设计假说,而不是真实物体的第二张照片.

blocks.en: We keep the source geometry, front material observation, model checkpoint, and sampling settings fixed. Front and back material observations are combined on the shared surface before native material encoding. The diagonal input–render comparison shows reference-view fidelity, while the back and opposite rear oblique views show how the edited motifs are carried onto the complete asset.
blocks.zh: 我们保持源几何,前材料观察,模型检查点和取样设置固定. 在原生材料编码之前,在共享地表上结合了前相和后相材料观测. 对角输入- 递归比较 显示参考视图的忠实性, 而背面和反面的后斜面视图 则显示编辑后动因如何被带入完整资产 。
